C1208.title: Quishing scams dupe millions of Americans as hackers turn QR codes into phishing weapons
C1208.summary: A CNBC report reveals that hackers are exploiting the public's willingness to scan QR codes to launch 'quishing' attacks, impacting tens of millions of Americans. Attackers place malicious codes in public spaces or distribute them through digital channels, tricking users into visiting phishing sites or divulging personal information, highlighting the widespread threat of QR codes as an attack vect
